title: Find the full name, Wiki Pedia page link, and date of birth of German drive
question:
Find the full name, Wiki Pedia page link, and date of birth of German drivers born between 1971 and 1985. List it in descending order of date of birth.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: FFull name refers to forname+surname; Nationality refers to German; Date of birth refers to dob; year(dob) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985'
